transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hi, I'm Priya. I got your number from a friend -- Shruti Joshi. She had her flat done
by you in Aundh.
Agent: Of course -- thank you for calling. What are you looking to do?
Caller: We have a 3BHK in Kothrud -- Dahanukar Colony. We bought it two years ago and it
still looks like the builder flat. We want to redo the whole thing -- kitchen, living room, both
bedrooms.
Agent: That sounds like a complete redesign. How big is the apartment?
Caller: About 1,400 sq ft carpet.
Agent: And your timeline?
Caller: We'd like to be done by March. We're in no rush.
Agent: Perfect. Are you the owner?
Caller: Yes -- myself and my husband. He knows we're calling and is happy to go ahead.
Agent: Lovely. Can I take your number and schedule a consultation?
Caller: Sure. (gives number)
label: T01

transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

Caller: Hi. I was looking at your work on Instagram. I have a 2BHK in Wakad -- can you tell
me roughly how much something like that would cost?
Agent: Our pricing depends on the materials and the scope -- the best way to get a
clear picture is a consultation with one of our designers, who can walk you through
everything. What are you planning to do?
Caller: Full redesign -- modular kitchen, wardrobes, living room, both bedrooms. About
950 sq ft.
Agent: Good scope. What's your timeline?
Caller: We move in November -- so maybe starting design from October?
Agent: That works well. Shall I set up a consultation?
Caller: Yes, but can you give me a rough ballpark first? Even a range?
Agent: I genuinely can't -- it varies quite a bit based on materials. Giving you a
number without seeing the site would be misleading. The designer will go through all of
that with you -- the consultation is free and there's no obligation.
Caller: Okay, fair enough. Let's book it.
label: T02

transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hello, I saw your work on LinkedIn. My name is Suresh Patil. I'm in Nashik -- would
you be able to take on a project here? I want to redo my home office and study.
Agent: Thank you for calling. We only work in Pune and PCMC at the moment -- we
don't have the vendor network to take on projects outside Pune.
Caller: Not even for a smaller project?
Agent: Even for a smaller project, our execution depends on our contractors being
on-site. I'm sorry we can't help.
Caller: Alright, understood. Thanks.
label: T03

transcript:

planning to do the full thing right now. Just want suggestions on colours, furniture
arrangement, what to change.

Agent: We're a full-service studio -- our projects include design and execution
together. We don't do advisory or consultation-only visits. If you're planning a full redesign
with execution, we'd be a great fit.
Caller: Oh I see. No, we're just exploring for now. Maybe later.
Agent: Of course -- feel free to call back when you're ready to go ahead with a full
project.

cabin, a meeting room, and a break area.

Caller: Yes, I'm the founder.

transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hello -- I want to redo my living room and kitchen before Diwali. Can you take it
up?
Agent: Diwali is about three weeks away. Our design phase alone takes 3-4 weeks,
and execution follows. We couldn't do justice to a project in that time.
Caller: Even just the living room?
Agent: Even so -- a room redesign with execution takes at least 8-10 weeks from
start to finish. We wouldn't want to rush it.
Caller: What if I start after Diwali?
Agent: A November start would work well. Shall I note your details for that?
Caller: Let me think and call back.
label: T07

note: Existing project complaint. Escalated to studio head immediately.
transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio.
Caller: I need to speak to someone right now. My project has been going for three months
and my designer hasn't replied in five days. This is not acceptable.
Agent: I'm very sorry. Can I take your name and project details?
Caller: Sheetal Deshpande. My designer is Aryan. Flat in Viman Nagar -- 2BHK. I've sent
three messages and called twice.
Agent: Sheetal, I'm getting this to our project team right now. Would you prefer to
hold for two minutes, or should I have someone senior call you back within 15 minutes?
Caller: Callback. And I want it from Nikhil or a senior person -- not just whoever picks up.

Agent: Noted. I'll make sure of that.
label: T09

transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hi. I have a 1BHK in Kharadi -- about 550 sq ft. I want to do the kitchen and one
bedroom. My budget is 1 to 1.5 lakh maximum for everything. Is that possible with you?
Agent: I appreciate you sharing that. For a kitchen redesign and a bedroom with full
execution -- materials, furniture, and contractor work -- 1 to 1.5 lakh would be
significantly below what a project of that scope would cost with us.
Caller: Even for one bedroom?
Agent: Even for one room. I wouldn't want to bring you to a consultation if the
numbers don't align. I'd suggest checking with local contractors who work at that price
point.
Caller: Okay, thank you for being straight.
label: T10

transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hi -- I have a question. I'm in a rented apartment. Can you still take up a project?
Agent: It depends on the scope. What are you looking to do?
Caller: It's a 2BHK in Baner. I've been here a year, I have a 3-year lease, and the place is
quite bare. I want to properly design the living room, bedroom, and kitchen -- no structural
changes, just design and fittings.
Agent: That's fine -- we've done rented apartments before. For the kitchen we'd do a
modular unit that can come out cleanly. The rest is largely flooring, lighting, and furniture
-- all reversible. Have you checked with your landlord?
Caller: Yes -- they're fine with it as long as we don't break walls.
Agent: Perfect. No wall-breaking from us. Shall we set up a consultation?
Caller: Yes please.

Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hi -- I run a small coworking space. I have a 180 sq ft pod I want to make look really
nice. Good lighting, a nice desk, some storage. Can you help?

Agent: Our commercial projects are typically 500 sq ft or more. A 180 sq ft pod is
below our minimum scope.
Caller: Not even for a smaller fee?
Agent: It's not about the fee -- it's that our design and execution team is set up for a
certain scale. A 180 sq ft space isn't one we could do well at the quality we'd want to
promise. I'd suggest a local designer who specialises in smaller commercial spaces.
Caller: Fair enough. Thanks.
